customManagers.description: Pinned container images in role defaults (semaphore_image, dockhand_image, ...). Not hawser: its image moved into the compose file in docker-stacks, where Renovate bumps it natively.

The same pins restated in the role README tables, both language variants. Without this Renovate updates defaults/main.yml alone, and spec-guards check 14 then fails the very pull request the bot just opened — with nothing the bot can do to satisfy it.

The docker-stacks commit the Hawser compose is fetched from. Nothing else links the two repositories: edit hawser/docker-compose.yml there and it reaches no node until this pin moves, with no error anywhere to say so. The pin stays deliberate (a floating ref would let any docker-stacks commit recreate the agent container fleet-wide, which is how pl-1 was stranded) — this only means the bot proposes the bump and merging it is the decision. Watches the branch head, not the hawser/ path, so an unrelated commit there opens a no-op pull request; the fetched content is then identical and nodes report changed=0.
